title: Equipment & Vehicle Loans Late-Charge Percentage for Members with Recent Delinquency
content:
**Tariff provision.** The late-charge percentage of an Equipment & Vehicle Loans installment's late charge follows the member's recent delinquency: when the loan carries a late charge dated less than 24 whole months before the booking date and an operating line of the member also carries a late charge dated less than 24 whole months before the booking date, the percentage is 6.0; when exactly one of the two carries such a late charge, the percentage is 5.5; when neither does, the product's late-charge percentage applies. The percentage so set is the late-charge percentage applied to the unpaid part of the installment.

## Records the percentage rests on

- **The equipment loan:** late-charge fee entries on the loan itself, dated less than 24 whole months before the day the new charge is booked.
- **The member's Operating Lines of Credit:** late-charge fee entries in the transaction history of any operating line the member holds, dated less than 24 whole months before the booking date.

## Percentage by combination

| Late charge on the equipment loan within 24 whole months | Late charge on an operating line within 24 whole months | Late-charge percentage |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 6.0 |
| yes | no | 5.5 |
| no | yes | 5.5 |
| no | no | the product's late-charge percentage |

## The 24-month window on both sides

Hypothetical booking date 15 March 2027:

| Earlier late charge dated | Whole months before the booking date | Counts |
|---|---|---|
| 16 March 2025 | less than 24 | yes |
| 15 March 2025 | 24 | no |

## Points of judgement

- One late charge on either record within the window is enough for that record to count; several do not raise the percentage further.
- Hypothetical: a Grain Storage & Handling Loan member whose loan has no late charge in the window but whose operating line was charged late 10 months ago takes 5.5, not the product's own figure.
